tasks.short: Collaborate on equipment, instrumentation and experimental procedures

steps.what: Collaborate with scientists to design, develop and test equipment, instrumentation and experimental procedures

tasks.design: Retain collaborative physical reasoning, equipment development and experimental testing with the physicist, using shared evidence in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} instrumentation and experimental analysis environment. Existing tools support the discussion and measurements without replacing joint interpretation or experimental judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment behaviour and experimental validity depend on physical assumptions and interfaces understood across disciplines.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital records make evidence available, but this digest does not establish a new reduction in collaborative development and testing time.
tasks.still_hard: An instrument can produce precise readings while measuring the wrong effect or disturbing the experiment.
tasks.human_edge: The physicist recognises physical confounders and resolves technical disagreements with collaborators.
tasks.altitude: Collaborative research effort and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Relate instrument behaviour to the intended physical measurement

evidence.claim: Retaining joint experimental equipment development and testing is a model-knowledge boundary; the digest does not provide a measured replacement for this collaboration.

assumptions: Boundary is the physicist's collaborative design, development and test reasoning, not collaborators' labour or separate regulatory release of equipment.

Collaborators provide initial requirements and existing evidence; participants produce new observations during the joint investigation. Focal-role explanation, testing, interpretation and finding capture remain fully counted in s1.
No ready calibrated, valid-measurement or equipment-safe flag is presumed. Missing or conflicting evidence leads to manual investigation and testing.
Test native instrument and analysis functions before custom software. OTHER denotes instrumentation and experimental analysis systems.
No new automation or capture requirement is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero and existing instrument runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Division of experimental and release responsibilities
research_questions: Which disagreements require new measurements rather than better document access?

already_counted.description: Collaborative physical reasoning, development and testing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net zero with zero added upkeep. Joint experimental development and testing retain full time; no reporting baseline is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write research funding proposals from a checked scientific brief

steps.what: Define the research question, contribution, methods, resources and fit with the funding call
Write research proposal sections explaining the planned work, evidence, milestones and resource justification

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose from a physicist-defined research plan
loop.input: scientific proposal brief, selected sources and funding-call requirements
loop.output: proposal draft with source-linked claims and explicit unresolved requirements
loop.check: Physicist checks novelty claims, physical feasibility, method meaning and consistency of milestones and resource justification with the brief
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported scientific claims or unresolved requirements return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed form cannot explain varied scientific contributions and methodological reasoning

steps.what: Verify scientific accuracy and accept the exact proposal for institutional review

tasks.design: Use an approved drafting function in {DOCS} to explain the scientific plan already defined by the physicist. The physicist checks sources, feasibility and resource consistency before accepting the exact proposal for separate institutional review and submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clear proposal prose required substantial drafting after the scientific direction and resources were established.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded first draft can propose wording while retaining scientific authorship and source checking.
tasks.still_hard: Persuasive prose may overstate novelty, feasibility or the strength of previous results.
tasks.human_edge: The physicist chooses the research contribution and recognises what can credibly be promised.
tasks.altitude: Some first-draft effort may fall; research direction and scientific acceptance remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check call requirements and the route to institutional submission
reach.learn: Separation of scientific claims, eligibility and institutional commitments

evidence.claim: A source-grounded research proposal drafting loop is a model-knowledge design; no measured physics proposal-writing saving is established in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific proposal preparation and acceptance for institutional review, not formal grant submission, funder evaluation or institutional budget approval.

In fully retained s1 the physicist captures the question, contribution, methods, source versions, work packages, milestones, resource amounts and call requirements. Finance and collaborators supply existing resource information; extra clarification receives a separate allowance.
The loop reads that brief directly. No ready eligible-proposal, novel-result or approved-budget flag is presumed; missing information returns to manual clarification and writing.
Test native templates and permitted drafting functions before custom code. Funding-call restrictions and confidentiality must be confirmed locally before use.
Final scientific checking remains full time; drafting and source maintenance and additional funding support have explicit allowances.
research_questions: Can reviewed drafts reduce writing effort without increasing corrections to scientific promises or call fit?

already_counted.description: Check and correct proposal prose against the scientific plan
Final scientific accuracy and acceptance check

incremental.description: Maintain proposal drafting checks and source handling
Funding and finance staff resolve additional call or resource ambiguities

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposal text, scientific brief, resource figures and call version checked in s3; changes void scientific acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=84; gross 16 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 9. Range covers novel proposals requiring manual prose and limited first-draft reuse; research choices and scientific acceptance retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design physical simulations with independently checked implementation drafts

steps.what: Define physical equations, approximations, boundary conditions, numerical methods and independent simulation checks
Design computer simulation implementations representing the specified physical model and numerical method

loop.purpose: Draft numerical implementation after the physicist specifies the physical model
loop.input: simulation specification, units, boundary conditions and independent reference checks
loop.output: implementation draft with equation mappings and test outputs
loop.check: Physicist checks physical equation meaning, dimensional consistency, conservation, analytic limits and convergence against independent references
loop.stop: One implementation and one correction; failed or ambiguous checks return to manual coding and analysis
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native solver configuration first; bespoke coupled models may still require code that a fixed template cannot supply

steps.what: Validate physical behaviour and accept the simulation version within its stated interpretation limits

tasks.design: First test native numerical solver configuration in the {OTHER} physics simulation environment. Where bespoke implementation remains necessary, draft it from the physicist's specification in {DOCS}, then retain independent numerical and physical validation before accepting the exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning a physical formulation into a numerical implementation required coding work in addition to scientific model design.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded code drafting can assist implementation while reference checks and physicist inspection remain part of the workflow.
tasks.still_hard: A simulation can converge numerically while representing the wrong approximation or physical mechanism.
tasks.human_edge: The physicist distinguishes numerical success from a useful explanation of the observed phenomenon.
tasks.altitude: Some implementation work may fall; physical model design and scientific acceptance stay unchanged.

reach.task: Check convergence and discretisation effects independently of the generated implementation
reach.learn: Analytic benchmarks and numerical error control

evidence.claim: Bounded simulation implementation drafting from explicit physics is a model-knowledge design; the digest does not measure physics simulation coding savings or correctness.

assumptions: Boundary is simulation design, implementation and research acceptance, not original physical data collection or later scientific publication.

The physicist produces equations, approximations, variable units, parameters, initial conditions, numerical choices and independent reference cases in fully retained s1. No ready physically-correct or complete-specification flag is assumed.

The implementation loop starts only after s1. Missing parameters or inconsistent equations return to manual scientific work; all code inspection and correction remain in s2, with final physical validation in s3.
Test native solver configuration before generating bespoke code. OTHER denotes physics simulation and numerical analysis software. Solver runtime earns no labour saving.
Accepted scope and limitations are recorded rather than assuming general predictive validity. Dependency and reference-test upkeep receive explicit allowances.
unknowns: Availability of independent analytic or experimental checks
Actual coding share of simulation design
research_questions: Does assisted implementation reduce total effort after convergence, conservation and physical validation checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect and correct numerical implementation and physical mappings
Validate and accept the physical simulation

incremental.description: Maintain reference tests and numerical dependencies
Numerical specialist reviews additional implementation ambiguities

approvals.approved_version: Exact implementation version, physical specification, parameters, validation results and interpretation scope checked in s3; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=84; gross 16 minus 9 focal upkeep gives central net 7. Range covers fully manual novel implementations and modest coding reuse; scientific formulation and physical acceptance retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach physics with reviewed explanatory material drafts

steps.what: Set physics learning goals and choose correct examples, demonstrations and explanations for the students
Prepare explanatory notes and practice examples from the checked teaching brief

loop.purpose: Draft explanations and practice wording from selected physics examples
loop.input: teaching brief, verified examples and intended learning goals
loop.output: teaching material draft with worked explanations and source references
loop.check: Physicist checks equations, units, reasoning and whether simplification creates a misconception; solves every proposed example independently
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; uncertain reasoning or unsuitable examples are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific explanations need language judgement beyond fixed worksheet layout

steps.what: Check the materials, teach physics interactively and address students' reasoning and questions

tasks.design: Draft explanatory notes from selected sources and examples in {DOCS}. The physicist verifies the materials and retains live teaching, demonstrations and responsive discussion with students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a first explanation required preparation effort even after the learning objective and examples were chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose wording while the physicist checks physical reasoning and educational suitability.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent worked explanation can contain a subtle error or reinforce a common misconception.
tasks.human_edge: The physicist responds to the student's actual reasoning and changes the explanation when understanding is incomplete.
tasks.altitude: Some preparation may fall; teaching responsibility and student interaction stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: A reviewed physics explanation drafting loop is a model-knowledge design; no measured teaching saving is supplied by this digest.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and delivery of physics instruction, not grading, formal assessment or students' own learning time.
In fully retained s1 the physicist captures learning goals, level, chosen examples, verified solutions, source versions and expected misconceptions. No ready pedagogically-suitable flag is assumed.
The loop reads that brief directly. Missing or uncertain solutions return to manual preparation; students' live questions arise in s3 and remain fully handled there.
Test native templates and permitted drafting functions before custom code. Final checking, live explanation and demonstrations keep all their time.
Drafting-check maintenance and occasional specialist clarification receive explicit allowances; no student-data processing is required.
unknowns: Actual share of repeated explanatory preparation
research_questions: Can reviewed explanatory drafts reduce preparation without increasing physical errors or student misconceptions?

already_counted.description: Verify reasoning and independently check drafted examples

incremental.description: Maintain teaching drafting checks and verified examples
Teaching colleagues clarify source or example ambiguities

approvals.approved_version: Exact teaching material and example-solution version checked before use in s3; changed explanations require fresh checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94; gross 6 minus 4 focal upkeep gives central net 2. Range covers bespoke teaching and a small repeated-explanation component; live instruction and final checking remain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Some proposal prose, simulation implementation and teaching preparation may fall; scientific formulation, experiments and teaching judgement remain with the physicist.
reach: Use independent checks with numerical specialists
Learn misconception diagnosis with physics educators
role.ambitious_version: A physicist who makes computational and written work easier to review while keeping claims grounded in physical evidence.
